name: Ouroboros - Self-Feeding Agent Loop
description: Autonomous agent that feeds its own follow-up prompts back into itself, like a serpent consuming its own tail. The agent plans, executes, and decides its own next step each turn until the task is complete.
author: AionUi

descriptionI18n.en-US: Self-feeding agent loop. The agent generates its own follow-up prompts and feeds them back as queue messages, autonomously iterating until the task is complete.
descriptionI18n.zh-CN: 自馈循环智能体。智能体自行生成后续提示并作为队列消息回馈给自己，自主迭代直至任务完成。

en-US: Build a REST API with authentication and CRUD endpoints
Refactor this codebase to use the repository pattern
Create a CLI tool that processes CSV files and outputs reports
Set up a CI/CD pipeline with testing and deployment stages
zh-CN: 构建一个带认证和 CRUD 端点的 REST API
将此代码库重构为仓储模式
创建一个处理 CSV 文件并输出报告的 CLI 工具
设置包含测试和部署阶段的 CI/CD 流水线

queuedMessages.description: Self-feeding loop: onQueueInit seeds the first analysis turn, onAgentResponse reads .ouroboros/state.json and feeds the agent's own nextPrompt back as the next queue message until status is 'done'

phases.purpose: Seed initial analysis and planning turn
Feed agent's self-generated follow-up prompt back as next turn
